objective: Find a legal order and a smallest set of names whose omission leaves every remaining pair nested by an interval calculation on the graph of permitted orders, with quadratic indexed time and space.
status: Proved: A deterministic quadratic-time and quadratic-space calculation on the graph of legal stage orders recovers the globally minimum number of exceptional names, an attaining order and the set of exceptions.
title: The exact minimum number of exceptional names over all branch orders
